source: docs/content/word-images.md 2·3번 (2026-11-15). 표를 고치면 이 파일도 함께 고친다

words.name: sushi
words.subject: Two pieces of nigiri sushi side by side on a small low wooden geta board, one topped with a soft orange-red tuna slice and one with a yellow rolled egg omelet tied with a thin dark nori band, seen from the front and slightly above.

words.name: ika
words.subject: One single piece of squid nigiri sushi: a pale off-white squid slice with fine diagonal score lines draped over an oval block of white rice, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate.

words.name: tako
words.subject: One single piece of octopus nigiri sushi: a slice of boiled octopus tentacle with a soft orange-red outer skin edge and a white inner cut face, three small round suction cup bumps along the skin edge, laid over an oval block of white rice, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate, no blue, no purple, nothing else.

words.name: maguro
words.subject: One single piece of lean tuna nigiri sushi: a thick slice of solid deep orange-red lean tuna in one flat color with no white fat stripes, draped over an oval block of white rice, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate, not salmon, nothing else.

words.name: tonkatsu
words.subject: A Japanese tonkatsu plate: one whole thick fried pork cutlet with a golden-brown panko crust, cut crosswise into five parallel slices with pale cream-white meat showing at each cut, lying on a small round pale cream plate next to a fluffy heap of finely shredded pale yellow-green cabbage, seen from the front and slightly above, no chopsticks, no sauce, no bowls, no nori, nothing else.
words.note: 처음에는 item-art/source/tonkatsu.png(젓가락으로 집은 아이템 그림)를 복사해 썼다. 2026-11-15 2차 검수에서 접시에 담은 돈카츠로 새로 그림

words.name: katsudon
words.subject: A dark indigo donburi bowl of rice topped with sliced golden tonkatsu simmered in soft yellow egg and thin onion strips, a few small moss olive leaves on top, seen from the front and slightly above, no lid, no chopsticks, no steam.

words.name: hirekatsu
words.subject: Three thick round fried pork fillet cutlets on a small round pale cream plate, each one a thick puck shape covered all over in a rough golden-brown panko breadcrumb crust drawn as many small bumpy crumbs along its whole outline, the front cutlet cut in half showing pale cream-white meat inside a golden crust ring, seen from the front and slightly above, no cabbage, no sauce, not bread, not buns, not cookies, nothing else.

words.name: gohan
words.subject: A small round dark indigo rice bowl filled with a soft dome of white rice, seen from the front and slightly above, no chopsticks, no steam.

words.name: udon
words.subject: A deep round dark indigo bowl of hot udon: thick glossy white udon noodles in light brown broth with a few thin moss olive scallion rings, seen from the front and slightly above, no chopsticks, no steam.

words.name: soba
words.subject: A deep round dark indigo bowl of hot soba: thin light brown buckwheat noodles in dark brown broth, topped only with a few small thin muted moss olive scallion rings, seen from the front and slightly above, no other toppings, no eggs, no balls, no chopsticks, no steam.

words.name: zaru
words.subject: A square flat bamboo zaru tray made of thin warm wood brown slats, with a neat heap of cold thin light brown soba noodles on it and a few thin dark nori strips sprinkled on top, seen from the front and slightly above, nothing else around it: no dipping cup, no bowls, no balls, no circles, no plates.

words.name: eki
words.subject: A small Japanese countryside train station seen from the front: a long low station building with pale cream walls and a wide dark indigo tiled roof, a wide open entrance with a ticket gate inside, a large round white clock with two hands on the front wall above the entrance, a long blank pale cream name board under the roof edge, and straight train rails with a short platform running in front of the building, no door, no house windows, no text.

words.name: otsuri
words.subject: Change from a Japanese ticket machine: a small shallow rectangular pale sky blue metal coin tray seen from the front and slightly above, holding exactly three flat round coins lying flat on its bottom: one warm yellow coin and two plain pale cream silver coins, each coin a flat solid disc with a thin raised rim and no hole, no numbers, no purple, nothing else.

words.name: kippuuriba
words.subject: A Japanese train station ticket vending machine seen from the front: a wide pale cream box machine that is wider than it is tall, with a large blank pale sky blue touch screen in the middle, a small coin slot and a bill slot on the right side, a narrow ticket and change outlet at the bottom, standing directly on its flat base, no legs, no text, no numbers.

words.name: omamori
words.subject: One Japanese omamori amulet: a small flat upright rectangular soft orange-red brocade pouch with a gently pointed top, a thin warm yellow border pattern, and a thin pale cream cord tied in a decorative knot at the top center with two short loops, front view, flat like a card, the front completely blank with no characters, not a bag, not a sack, nothing else.

words.name: omikuji
words.subject: A row of seven narrow white paper fortune slips, each folded into a thin strip and tied in a small knot around a single horizontal warm wood brown wooden rail, the slip ends hanging down below the rail, front view, blank paper with no writing, nothing else: no balls, no circles, no colored shapes, no banner.

words.name: takoyaki
words.subject: Six round takoyaki balls, all the same golden brown color, packed in a boat-shaped warm wood brown tray, every ball covered with glossy dark brown sauce and thin white mayonnaise zigzag lines and a few tiny moss olive aonori flakes, one wooden pick stuck in one ball, seen from the front and slightly above, no blue, no purple, no bonito flakes, no steam.

words.name: ringoame
words.subject: One whole candy apple coated in a smooth soft orange-red candy shell, on a straight wooden stick pointing down, upright, front view.

words.name: yakitori
words.subject: One bamboo skewer of Japanese yakitori: four same-sized chunks of grilled chicken thigh, all the same glossy warm brown color with a dark brown soy glaze and small darker grill marks, threaded in a straight vertical line, upright with the bare stick end at the bottom, front view, no vegetables, no other colors, no plate.

words.name: tsukune
words.subject: One bamboo skewer holding a single long oval chicken meatball shaped like a stretched capsule, all glossy dark brown teriyaki glaze with a few darker grill marks, upright with the bare stick end at the bottom, front view, only one piece on the stick, no round balls, no egg, no plate.

words.name: onigiri
words.subject: A plain grilled yaki onigiri rice ball shown as food only: a rounded triangle of rice entirely coated in a toasty golden-brown soy glaze with a few darker brown grill marks, no nori, front view, upright, its surface completely plain with no eyes, no smile, no cheeks.

words.name: yu
words.subject: A Japanese public bath noren curtain hanging from a thin warm wood brown rod: one wide curtain of solid dark indigo cloth, the whole cloth the same dark indigo from top to bottom, split into two equal panels by one vertical slit in the lower half only, with one large plain pale cream circle in the upper middle of the cloth above the slit, the circle left completely empty, front view, no other colors, no stripes, no text.
words.note: ゆ는 가운데 빈 원에 KanjiVG 획으로 합성한다(brief.md 1.2). 합성은 이번 배치에서 하지 않는다

words.name: onsen
words.subject: A small round outdoor hot spring pool seen from the front and slightly above: a ring of rounded warm beige-brown stones around pale sky blue water, no people, no steam.

words.name: yukata
words.subject: A cotton yukata robe with a simple dark indigo and white pattern, hung open flat on a horizontal warm wood brown kimono hanger with a narrow soft orange-red sash draped over it, front view.

words.name: houjicha
words.subject: One traditional Japanese yunomi teacup: a tall straight-sided cylindrical cup with no handle, pale cream with one thin dark indigo band near the rim, filled with reddish warm brown roasted tea, seen from the front and slightly above so the round tea surface shows, no saucer, no steam, not a mug, not a coffee cup.

words.name: ofuro
words.subject: A square Japanese bathtub made of pale warm wood planks (hinoki cypress), filled with pale sky blue water, a small round wooden bucket resting on the rim, seen from the front and slightly above, no steam.

words.name: futon
words.subject: A thin Japanese floor futon set seen from the front and slightly above at an angle: a thin white mattress only a few centimeters thick lying flat with nothing under it, a dark indigo quilt folded back halfway, and a small rectangular pillow, no bed frame, no legs, no headboard, not a western bed.

words.name: ikura
words.subject: One single gunkan sushi: an oval of white rice wrapped in a band of dark nori, heaped on top with round shiny orange salmon roe beads, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate.

words.name: ebi
words.subject: One single piece of shrimp nigiri sushi: a butterflied cooked shrimp with soft orange-red and white stripes and a fanned tail, over an oval block of white rice, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate.

words.name: inari
words.subject: One single inari sushi: a plump oval pouch of golden-brown sweet fried tofu stuffed with white rice, the rice showing at the open top, seen from the front and slightly above, no plate.

words.name: oroshi
words.subject: One fried pork cutlet cut into thick slices on a small round pale cream plate, the golden-brown panko crust drawn with a bumpy crumb outline and pale cream-white meat showing at each cut, topped in the middle with a small white mound of grated daikon radish and a few thin muted moss olive scallion rings, seen from the front and slightly above, no sauce, not a pancake, not bread, nothing else.

words.name: wakame
words.subject: A deep round dark indigo bowl of hot udon with thick white noodles, topped with a heap of dark olive (#34402F) wakame seaweed, seen from the front and slightly above, no steam.

words.name: tanuki
words.subject: A deep round dark indigo bowl of hot soba with thin light brown noodles, topped with a heap of small crunchy golden tempura bits and a few scallion rings, seen from the front and slightly above, no steam.

words.name: okame
words.subject: A deep round dark indigo bowl of soba topped with several separate toppings arranged in a ring: pink-and-white kamaboko fish cake slices, a brown simmered shiitake, a yellow omelet slice, seen from the front and slightly above, no steam.
words.hold: 고명 구성 확인 필요(word-images.md 2.3, giri-lines.md). 확인 뒤 hold를 지우고 생성한다

words.name: noriba
words.subject: A short section of a train platform edge with a yellow tactile paving strip, and the side of a pale cream commuter train with an open door stopped beside it, seen from the front at a slight angle, no signs.

words.name: omatsuri
words.subject: One round paper chochin lantern in soft orange-red with a pale cream band at the top and bottom, hanging from a short cord, front view, blank with no characters.

words.name: yakisoba
words.subject: A heap of brown sauce-fried yakisoba noodles with small pieces of cabbage and a little soft orange-red pickled ginger on top, in a rectangular white paper food tray, seen from the front and slightly above, no steam.

words.name: kawa
words.subject: One bamboo skewer threaded with wavy, crispy golden-brown folded chicken skin, upright with the bare stick end at the bottom, front view, no plate.

words.name: shiitake
words.subject: One bamboo skewer with two grilled shiitake mushroom caps in warm brown, each cap with a cross-shaped cut on top, upright with the bare stick end at the bottom, front view, no plate.

words.name: uzura
words.subject: One bamboo skewer with four small boiled quail eggs, pale cream with a light brown glaze, upright with the bare stick end at the bottom, front view, no plate.

words.name: kutsuonuide
words.kana: くつをぬいでください
words.subject: A small section of a Japanese entrance: a low stone floor with a pair of sneakers placed neatly side by side, and a raised warm wood brown step behind it with a pair of pale cream slippers on top, seen from the front at a slight angle.

words.name: oheya
words.subject: A low square warm wood brown Japanese table with a small teapot and one teacup on it and two flat square floor cushions beside it, resting on a single pale tatami mat, seen from the front and slightly above, no walls.
